name: sWamp
author: gasserx
description: Retro late-90s style music player with a spectrum analyzer, playlist with folder view, search (artist, title, genre, year or decade), a multi-genre filter and 20 vintage picture skins. Pair it with mp3tidy to set correct genres. Adds a gold sWamp button to the bar.

barWidget.description: Open, bring here or minimize the sWamp player; tooltip shows what's playing.
